# Backtesting & evaluation

[← README](../README.md) · [← Risk & guardrails](risk.md) · [Benchmarks & leaderboards →](benchmarks.md) · [简体中文](evaluation.zh-CN.md)

Engines and harnesses for testing a strategy before it touches money. For LLM agents the extra hazard is look-ahead bias through the model's training data.

9 entries, by stars. Add one by editing `data/entries/evaluation.yaml`.

- [Qlib](https://github.com/microsoft/qlib) - AI-oriented quant research platform from Microsoft covering data, model training, backtesting and the RD-Agent automated research loop. `equities` `research` <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/microsoft/qlib?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=" alt="stars">
- [Nautilus Trader](https://github.com/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader) - Rust-native, event-driven trading engine with deterministic backtesting and the same strategy code for live deployment. `multi-asset` `research` <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=" alt="stars">
- [vectorbt](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt) - Vectorised backtesting and research engine for testing large numbers of trading ideas quickly in Python. `multi-asset` `research` <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/polakowo/vectorbt?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=" alt="stars">

- [StockBench](https://github.com/ChenYXxxx/stockbench) - Benchmark that evaluates LLMs on multi-step stock trading decisions using post-2024 price, fundamental and news data to avoid training contamination. · no commits in 12 months `equities` `research` <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ChenYXxxx/stockbench?style=flat-square&labelColor=2b2b2b&color=6b6b6b&label=" alt="stars">
